messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH — prefills causing repeated GPU OOMs in us-west-2. Affected pool: gpu-prefill-prod-2. Containers restarting. Pager: @oncall-cole @sre-maria

oncall-cole: saw the alert. I'm on it, joining bridge now — starting triage.

sre-maria: joining. symptoms: repeated `cudaErrorIllegalInstruction` then `OOM` during prefill for long prompts (>= 64k tokens). Containers restart loop ~ every 30-90s.

runtime-raj: logs indicate KV-cache allocations spike before OOM, then cuda errors. Possible kvcache growth for streaming prefill. Posting log snippet:```2026-03-18T03:40:12Z runtime: prefill start token_count=67234 kv_alloc=12.1G gpu_mem_used=28.4G GPU0: cudaErrorIllegalInstruction; container PID 2431 killed by SIGKILL```

infra-alex: node metrics show GPU memory spiking on node ip-10-2-45-67. NVidia driver version 525.89.01. No recent driver pushes.

oncall-cole: traffic routing? how many customers impacted?

cs-janet: initial CS triage: two customers reported degraded streaming and intermittent failures (~5% of requests to this pool). One partner saw truncated replies but no data leak. I'll prepare a customer note.

sre-maria: immediate mitigation attempt: throttling prefill max_tokens to 32k at proxy layer for pool gpu-prefill-prod-2. Rolling that now as `prefill.max_tokens=32768` on route config.

ops-bot: config rollout started: route-config/gpu-prefill-prod-2 updated by sre-maria. Canaries 10%.

runtime-raj: good — also enabling aggressive KV trim for long-prefill sessions: `kvcache.trim_threshold=0.6` and `kvcache.max_entries=200000`. Pushing to canary.

oncall-cole: can we drain the worst node without killing other workloads?

infra-alex: initiating graceful drain of ip-10-2-45-67. Existing sessions allowed to finish for 30s, new routing avoids node. ETA 45s.

sre-maria: monitoring memory after throttle. If OOMs stop, we'll scale pool down and incrementally roll config to 100%.

25s later —

runtime-raj: canary shows OOMs dropped from ~18/min to ~2/min. Most remaining are for single-session heavy batched prefill.

oncall-cole: any quick code hotfix?

sre-maria: quick patch idea: short-circuit very large prefill requests to run in a coldmodel mode (streaming without large KV allocation). I can push a runtime flag `prefill.coldmodel=true` for >48k tokens. Want to test on canary.

ops-bot: patch build queued by runtime-raj: `build/2734` -> canary deploy.

cs-janet: preparing customer update: "We're observing GPU memory surges for long-context prefill in one routing pool; mitigation underway. Minimal customer impact observed; team will follow up."

runtime-raj: canary deploy looks stable for 6m; no new CUDA errors. Rolling to 50%.

infra-alex: drain completed on ip-10-2-45-67, node marked Maintenance.

oncall-cole: handoff checklist: confirm routing at 100%, confirm no OOMs for 20m, send customer update, and if stable, close page. Who owns postmortem?

sre-maria: I'll own the postmortem. Will gather traces, kvcache growth patterns, and propose longer-term: kvcache caps and per-request prefill guardrails.

cs-janet: sent customer note to affected accounts, will escalate to account leads if they ask for more details.

runtime-raj: long-term follow-ups: (1) enforce server-side prefill token limit + adaptive shedding, (2) add KV per-session hard cap and eviction policy, (3) add metric alert for rapid kv_alloc growth.

ops-bot: rollout complete: route-config/gpu-prefill-prod-2 => 100%. runtime hotflag `prefill.coldmodel=true` for >48k tokens enabled.

sre-maria: monitoring: 20m since mitigation, OOMs reduced to baseline (0-1/min), container restarts stopped.

oncall-cole: thanks team. I'll file a brief incident note and change status to Monitored. Paging cleared but leaving thread open for PM and postmortem items. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Incident #INC-2026-03018 created, severity: high -> promoted to monitored. Postmortem owner: sre-maria.

sre-maria: adding runbook action items: add prefill token guardrail, kvcache hard cap, add `cudaErrorIllegalInstruction` to auto-escalation filters, and test coldmodel path under heavy long-prefill load.

runtime-raj: copying perf traces to PRJ/INC-2026-03018/traces for postmortem.

cs-janet: will follow-up on customer comms tomorrow morning.

oncall-cole: handing off to night oncall @sre-maria for monitoring; if anything spikes, escalate to runtime-raj.

sre-maria: ack, I'll be on rotation.

end of thread.
